rules.condition: if self:has_guy() then g_set_exp(g_exp() + exp_from_action(self, friend, 'protection', 0))
rules.semantic: A hero druid earns experience for every friend it protects, whether the friend got a new ring or a top-up; a monster druid earns nothing.

rules.condition: if self.team == 0 or self:has_guy() then og.emit_notification(message)

rules.condition: if slot == 1 then f = nearest_living_foe(60,true); if f == nil or not pad_clear then false; return faces(f) and not at_blows(f)
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: GROW TREE pays only between the druid and a living foe closing on it: the nearest living foe within 60 px, faced, not yet at blows, with the bolt's pad clear.

rules.condition: elseif slot == 2 then if owned faerie > 0 then false; return foes_within(130) and pad_clear
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: SUMMON FAERIE pays with a living foe within 130 px, no faerie of the druid's out, and the bolt's pad clear.

rules.condition: elseif slot == 3 then return false
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: a druid bot never casts REVEAL (it only changes a viewscreen's radar).

rules.condition: ally = ally_at_blows(60); if not ally then false; return circle == nil or circle.hp < 50
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: PROTECTION pays for an ally within 60 px that a living foe is at blows with, and only if that ally has no circle or one under 50 hp.
